description: Evidence coverage trend gate 契约。门禁聚合 rule_depth_registry、classics_rule_index、CapabilityExecutor 输出和 capability Report evidenceRefs，检查规则引用断链、analysisEvidence trace 完整度、冲突解释和反证字段，并与 tracked baseline 比较。
inputSources: CapabilityExecutor bazi/ziwei 北京测试样本
requiredChecks: analysisEvidence items carry ruleIds, source/sources, basis and risk/riskBoundary
capability Report evidenceRefs carry id, source and ruleIds
capability Report evidenceRefs completeRatio stays at or above tracked baseline
baziRuleDepth/ziweiRuleDepth appliedRules carry ruleId, sourceRuleIds, evidenceFields, conditions, conflictPolicy and riskBoundary
conflictResolution conflicts carry explanation and counterEvidence
privacyBoundary: 门禁输出只保存计数、ratio、字段名、ruleId 和证据路径；不得复制完整报告正文、真实用户输入、真实地名字段、token、secret、DSN、私钥或生产日志 payload。
productionBoundary: status=passed 只表示本地 evidence coverage 未低于 tracked baseline 且规则引用未断链；不代表预测准确率、专业能力 100%、外部生产 live 或第三方审计通过。
